findings.title: UI fix is cosmetic-correct but does not close the underlying root cause (sentinel-polluted DB rows persist)
findings.evidence: PENDING_CREATE_<rand> sentinel is injected by User::creating boot hook (app/Models/User.php:106-122) when admin tooling/walk-in resolver creates rows without phone. The fix at the Vue layer hides display but the DB still carries the sentinel; any future admin export/CSV/SQL audit will include them.
findings.recommendation: Long-term root-cause heal (V1.0.2 backlog): phone-collection flow on first admin login OR backend admin migration to ask-and-fill phone for sentinel-tagged accounts. Audit query: SELECT id, name, email, phone FROM users WHERE phone LIKE 'PENDING_%' — surfaces every polluted row for follow-up. CLAUDE.md log message at User.php:115 already provides observability.

repair_recommendation_nf525_chain.FORBIDDEN_action: DO NOT DELETE audit_logs.id=34 — DB trigger BEFORE DELETE SIGNALs SQLSTATE '45000' on MySQL prod (CLAUDE.md §8). Even if SQLite local lacks the trigger, deleting violates NF525 immutability principle (6-year retention, append-only).
repair_recommendation_nf525_chain.RECOMMENDED_action: Append-only annotation. Write a new audit_logs row with action='tamper.acknowledged', resource='audit_log', resource_id=34, payload={'breach_origin':'E2E-08 healthz adversarial test fixture', 'breach_window':'2026-05-25 18:28:46', 'verified_by':'UR-2 ultra-review 2026-05-25', 'verify_chain_status':'permanent breach record — chain re-anchors at id=35'}. Use the standard AuditLogService::write() path — it computes prev_hash from current chain tail, so the new row will sit on top of the already-resumed chain without re-introducing a break.
repair_recommendation_nf525_chain.expected_post_repair_behavior: fiscal:verify-chain will STILL report breach at id=34 forever — that is correct NF525 behavior. The annotation row provides forensic documentation that the breach was reviewed and attributed. NF525 audit doctrine: chain history is immutable, breach is a permanent record, repair = annotation not erasure.
repair_recommendation_nf525_chain.alternative_radical_action_NOT_RECOMMEND: Some operators might consider a chain re-seal (regenerate hashes from id=34 onward with valid prev_hash). This would constitute hash forgery — explicitly forbidden by NF525 immutability principle. DO NOT do this. The breach must persist as a permanent record.
repair_recommendation_nf525_chain.execution_timing: Defer until next planned maintenance window. Not urgent — health/operational impact is zero (chain after id=34 is intact via natural re-anchor). Only forensic clarity is improved.
